text:
maria: Heads up — after yesterday's release (merged PR #3128) we're seeing a noticeable p95 decode latency regression for short-sequence chat requests. Shortseq p95 jumped ~30% on the canary fleet. Anyone else seeing this?

perf-bot: Alert: decode_p95_shortseq +32% in eu-west-1 vs baseline (1h). Spike started ~2026-03-17T22:10Z. Affected service: runtime-inference.

sam: ugh. Which change in the PR touched the kernel selector? PR looked small but the kernel routing table changed.

maria: The PR swapped the fallback ordering so fused-attn-autobatch is preferred for small heads. I suspected that might affect warmup behaviour. Repro steps I'm using: run local shortseq workload (bs=1, seq=16) against canary image -> repros reliably.

ashley: Can you paste the exact load command? I'll try on a different machine.

maria: curl -s -X POST https://canary.internal.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwkv-3b","input":"Hello","max_tokens":32}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' --repeat 500 --concurrency 4 (we send lots of short independent requests). p95 baseline ~42ms, new ~55ms.

jun: Ok, I'll start a quick bisect on the merge range. If the kernel selector mapping changed it's probably that one commit that toggled the "prefer fused when batchable" flag.

sam: If it's a selector heuristic bug, we might be mis-routing shortseq to a kernel that has higher per-token overhead (autobatch fusion has better throughput at larger request interarrival but worse per-request latency when warmup/kernels switch). Also check KV cache warmup — if the fused path is evicting KV lines more aggressively we lose prefix cache benefits.

maria: I ran perf on the canary and grabbed a flamegraph snippet. Key lines (summarized):
```
decode_path::handle_request 100ms
  -> kernel_router::choose(autobatch_fused) 35ms
  -> kv_cache::prefetch_miss 18ms
  -> attention_fused::dispatch 22ms
```
Not exact numbers but shows a large chunk in kernel_router + prefetch_miss.

jun: Bisect result: culprit is commit 7f9a3b2 — changed selector ordering and added a quick affinity heuristic. Reproduces locally when I checkout and run the shortseq test.

sam: Can you dump the selector decision for a few requests (model, seq_len, batch_agg_stat) with the canary build? We need to see why it picked fused.

maria: Dump example:
```
request_id: r1234 model: rwkv-3b seq: 12 global_inflight: 3 avg_arrival_ms: 14
selector: evaluated candidates [native_attn, fused_autobatch, matmul_fast]
scores: {native_attn: 0.42, fused_autobatch: 0.57, matmul_fast: 0.11}
chosen: fused_autobatch (reason: score +0.15 higher)
```
Decision weight currently favors duplex fused kernel for batchability.

ashley: That score delta seems noisy for short sequences. We should make the selector prefer native_attn when seq <= 32 and avg_arrival_ms < 20ms. Quick patch to additive bias would buy time.

jun: I'll open a patch to tweak the heuristic (PR #3187) to add a small negative bias to fused_autobatch when seq < 48. Also adding a unit test that simulates low-latency arrivals so we don't regress again.

sam: Before we merge a fix, can we try a config rollback on canary: set selector.override=fallback_to_native for 1% of nodes and measure p95? If that drops p95 for those nodes it's a strong signal.

deploy-bot: Can apply runtime config change: selector.override=prefer_native on targets [canary-1-*, canary-1b-*] at 2026-03-18T00:40Z. Confirm to proceed with 1% sample.

maria: Please run it. I'll monitor metrics.

perf-bot: Rolling window: nodes with selector.override=prefer_native saw decode_p95_shortseq drop from 55ms -> 43ms within 10m after change. Control nodes stayed at ~54-56ms.

sam: Great — that confirms it's selector choice. Action plan: jun's PR to fix heuristic + add simulation tests, then we pilot on canary with 5% rollout. If all good, full rollout next day. Also add a perf regression CI check for shortseq p95 against canary baseline.

ashley: Also add a KV cache regression test — I want to ensure fused path isn't causing extra evictions. We should capture kv_cache::hit_rate and kv_evictions per kernel path in next canary run.

jun: Working on PR now. Will include metrics instrumentation and the heuristic tweak. ETA ~2 hours.

maria: Thanks. If anyone hits more anomalies DM me. I'll keep the thread updated with metrics and bisect logs. :thumbsup:

sam: If jun's fix is blocked, we should have an emergency rollback prepared (revert commit 7f9a3b2). I don't love reverts but it's safer short-term.

jun: Noted. Opening PR and will request reviews from @sam and @maria.

maria: Closing loop: perf alert cleared on canary subset after config override. Still monitoring broader fleet.

perf-bot: Alert resolved: decode_p95_shortseq back to baseline on targeted nodes.

ashley: Good work. Document the selector behavior and add a note in the release notes for the next cut.

maria: Will do.
